note: Rewritten from the species-level description of Anenteotermes disluctans in Sands (1972), original in English; the species has no soldiers; measurement-table headings, figure numbers, type locality and the details of the specimen discussion on the merged taxa are not translated, and several OCR-corrupted figures in the measurement table are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alates smaller than A. hemerus, with the posterior margin of the postclypeus evenly rounded; A. improcinctus, A. nanus and A. polyscolus are all smaller than this species, and A. improelatans has a wider meso- and metanotal constriction and a reduced fontanelle. Among workers A. hemerus is still larger; the enteric valves of A. nanus and A. polyscolus bear spines and both are smaller, as is A. improcinctus, whose mandibular apical teeth are longer and whose fore tibia is slightly more inflated; A. improelatans has a much shorter mixed segment, and the first and second marginal teeth of the right mandible are equal in length. The two series of specimens originally separated from Uganda and Central Africa are merged into one species because they cannot be distinguished taxonomically; because of slight differences in the proportions of the antennal segments of the alates, the Central African material is provisionally excluded from the paratype series. The worker abdomen appears to be of the weakly dehiscent type.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and pilosity yellowish white, setae rather numerous but short, fine and pale, inconspicuous. Postclypeus moderately to strongly inflated, Pcl/W 0.27–0.36, Pcl/Ri 1.63–2.50. Mandibular apical teeth short, La/Li 0.46–0.53, Ra/Ri 0.54–0.65; the accessory marginal tooth of the left mandible is separated from the molar prominence in surface view by a distinct notch, composite ratio 9.63–11.85; the first marginal tooth of the right mandible lies distinctly behind the line from the apical tooth to the second marginal tooth, and its anterior margin is shorter than that of the second marginal tooth, composite ratio 11.61–16.65. Fore tibia slightly inflated, T1/Tw 4.18–4.41, the third apical spur well developed, almost as large as the other two. The overlap of midgut and hindgut slightly exceeds four times the midgut width at the attachment of the Malpighian tubules; the enteric valve seating is weakly trilobate, the third inner lobe smaller than the two outer lobes and connected by a short neck to the second hindgut pouch, lateral in the unopened abdomen; the enteric valve cushions are entirely retracted, with only a scaly surface, positions 3 and 4 slightly larger than positions 1 and 2; the membranous wall between the cushions and outside them bears sparse minute spines.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, darker above the ocelli; fontanelle about half the length of the ocellus, rather narrow oval, flat or slightly concave, yellow; the median spot short oval, smaller than the fontanelle, flat, concolorous with the head capsule; postclypeus brown, labrum yellowish brown; frontal mark a small slightly concave brown crescent; antennae yellowish brown. Pronotum brown, meso- and metanotal plates yellowish brown, transverse sutures weak or absent; femora pale yellowish brown, tibiae and tarsi yellow. Abdominal tergites yellowish brown, sternites pale yellowish brown laterally and yellow medially, the dorsal and ventral pleural spiracles dark; cerci yellow. Posterior margin of head capsule evenly rounded; ocelli medium-sized, separated from the compound eye by less than half their own minimum diameter, at most nearly their full length; postclypeus moderately to strongly inflated, Pcl/W 0.28–0.34, posterior margin evenly rounded but not always distinct, median suture present. Mandibular apical teeth short, La/Li 0.46–0.56, Ra/Ri 0.62–0.75; the accessory marginal tooth of the left mandible far from the molar prominence in surface view, composite ratio 6.76–8.51; the first marginal tooth of the right mandible slightly behind the line from the apical tooth to the second marginal tooth, the anterior margins of the marginal teeth equal in length, composite ratio 22.0–28.5. Head capsule pilosity brown, dense but uneven, not felt-like.
